name: Betrayal
text: The person who has been helping you suddenly vanishes with your Objects. Each Persona Represses Objects from Hand equal to Willpower minus Lucidity.

name: Chase
text: Spawn 1 Encounter on each Persona-occupied Landscape. If Elasticity exceeds Willpower, you may escape; otherwise Meet is your only action this round.

name: Heroism
text: You stand triumphant over your fallen foe. Each Persona Draws Psyche equal to their Willpower.

name: Injury
text: Each Persona Discards Psyche Cards valued higher than their Willpower.

name: Judgement
text: Awaken Leviathan on Sea of Teeth or Endless Ocean and move Leviathan to the nearest occupied Landscape.

name: Loss
text: Forget the four corners of the Patchwork Dreamscape. If corners are Wasteland, Forget adjacent Landscapes instead.

name: Misunderstanding
text: Repress top Mindstream cards equal to the number of players plus 3.

name: Mortality
text: Each Persona must Discard either 4 Psyche or 2 Objects.

name: Abandonment
text: Repress all Active Encounters. Personae on the same Landscape move to adjacent empty Landscapes.

name: Abduction
text: Move each Active Encounter 2 Landscapes away from The Bed; Personae moved with Encounters may only Meet this round.

name: Absurdity
text: Draw Personae+1 cards from each Mindstream. For each Event drawn, Forget Landscapes referenced on it.

name: Bargaining
text: All Personae may Discard 6 Psyche to Acquire 1 Archetype matching their suit.

name: Recovery
text: The sun breaks through the mist. Return 1 Card per Persona.

name: Responsibility
text: Each Persona Discards Psyche equal to player count unless they discard Willpower Psyche totaling player count.

name: Travel
text: Next Explore Phase, each Persona may move anywhere for free. Cannot take Landscape Actions next Meet Phase.

name: Wanderlust
text: If Personae Explore a total of three times player count Landscapes this round, all Personae Draw 3 Psyche.

name: Transformation
text: Next Meet phase, when Spawning an Encounter you may draw the top 2 Encounters and pick 1.

name: Trapped
text: Skip the next Explore Phase.

name: Lost
text: Forget all Landscapes adjacent to The Bed. Personae there pay the Wasteland cost.

name: Misplaced
text: Repress all your Objects unless you discard Willpower Psyche equal to the number of Objects you wish to save.

name: Rivalry
text: Draw 1 Encounter per 2 Players and place them on The Bed. Leftover Encounters cost 1 Psyche each at end of Meet.

name: Temptation
text: All Personae may discard up to 3 Objects to Draw that many Psyche.

name: Paradox
text: Next Meet Phase treat all Willpower costs as Elasticity and Elasticity as Willpower.

name: Powerlessness
text: Spawn 1 Encounter per Persona on unoccupied edge Landscapes.

name: Well Being
text: All Personae Draw 3 Psyche.

name: Quiet
text: Everything remains, nothing changes. Nothing Happens.

name: The Final Recurrence
text: All hopes and fears flood the Dreamscape. Remaining Archetypes must be Met with 12 Psyche using opposing suits.

name: Final Recurrence: DELTA
text: Forget 4 Edge Landscapes. All Personae Discard 1 Psyche.

name: Final Recurrence: THETA
text: Forget 8 Edge Landscapes. All Personae Draw 2 Psyche.

name: Final Recurrence: ALPHA
text: Forget 4 Edge Landscapes. All Personae Draw 1 Object.

name: Final Recurrence: BETA
text: Forget 4 Edge Landscapes. All Personae Draw 1 Psyche.

name: Final Recurrence: Circadia
text: All Personae draw up to 4 Psyche from Discard.

name: Final Recurrence: Somnambulance
text: All Personae Move 1 Landscape.

name: Final Recurrence: Homeostasis
text: Draw 5 Psyche.

name: Final Recurrence: Pineal Purge
text: Discard 3 Psyche.

name: You Never Wake Up
text: You Lose. Bottom of Final Recurrence Deck.
